name: Qrlastica – QR Code Generator with Logo
author: DigiDepot

sections.description:
Qrlastica is a QR code generator plugin for WordPress.

Create QR codes from URLs or text, customize the QR code color, add a logo, preview the result, and download the finished QR code.

Qrlastica also provides the [qrlastica] shortcode for displaying QR codes in WordPress posts and pages.

Logos used with copied shortcodes are saved in WordPress so they can be displayed on your website.

Features

  • Generate QR codes from URLs or text.
  • Add a custom logo or image.
  • Customize QR code colors.
  • Preview QR codes before use.
  • Download QR codes as PNG.
  • Download QR codes as SVG.
  • Display QR codes using the [qrlastica] shortcode.
  • Responsive design for desktop and mobile devices.

Usage

Open Qrlastica from the WordPress admin area and enter the URL or text you want to encode.

Customize the QR code color and optionally add a logo. You can preview the QR code and download it as PNG or SVG.

To display the QR code on your website, copy the Qrlastica shortcode and paste it into a post or page.

The basic shortcode is:

[qrlastica]<h3>Privacy</h3>

QR codes are generated in the browser.

When a logo is used with a copied shortcode, the logo is saved in WordPress so it can be displayed with the QR code on your website.

External Services

Qrlastica does not require an external QR code generation service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the qrlastica folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install Qrlastica through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate Qrlastica through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Qrlastica in the WordPress admin area.
  4. Create and customize your QR code.
  5. Copy the generated shortcode.
  6. Paste the shortcode into a WordPress post or page.
sections.faq:
What can I encode in a QR code?

You can create QR codes from URLs or text.

Can I add a logo?

Yes. You can add a custom logo or image to your QR code.

Can I change the QR code color?

Yes. Qrlastica includes QR code color customization.

Which download formats are supported?

Qrlastica supports PNG and SVG downloads.

Can I display a QR code on a WordPress page or post?

Yes. Qrlastica provides a shortcode that can be copied and added to WordPress posts or pages.

Does the QR code expire?

Qrlastica creates static QR codes based on the content you provide. The QR code itself does not expire. If it contains a URL, that URL must remain available for the QR code to continue leading to the intended page.
